description: Multi-pass extraction Pass 3: History & Employment - PROCESSING setting

system_messages.content:
Extract ONLY these fact types:

1. PRIOR_ACCIDENTS_DECLARED: Statements about prior accident history
   - DENIALS: 'has not been involved', 'no prior accidents' -> DENIED_PRIOR_INCIDENT, is_denial=true
   - ADMISSIONS: 'was involved in 2018 collision' -> HAD_PRIOR_INCIDENT, temporal_context='prior_incident'
   Include time_window if mentioned (e.g., 'in past 10 years')

2. PRIOR_ACCIDENTS_DOCUMENTED: Specific prior incidents with dates/details
   - 'was involved in a collision on June 10, 2018' -> HAD_PRIOR_INCIDENT, temporal_context='prior_incident'

3. EMPLOYMENT_SCOPE: Was person acting in course of employment?
   - WAS_IN_SCOPE: 'acting in course and scope', 'on company business'
   - WAS_NOT_IN_SCOPE: 'released from duty', 'personal errand', 'off the clock'

4. WORK_IMPACT: Time off work, disability
   - MISSED_WORK_FOR: duration of absence (e.g., '4 weeks', '3 days')

DENIALS ARE HIGH PRIORITY - extract them as explicit facts with is_denial=true.

OUTPUT FORMAT:
{"nodes": [
  {
    "node_type": "STATED_FACT",
    "id": "STATED_FACT_0",
    "text": "<fact statement>",
    "fact_category": "<PRIOR_ACCIDENTS_DECLARED|PRIOR_ACCIDENTS_DOCUMENTED|EMPLOYMENT_SCOPE|WORK_IMPACT>",
    "value_raw": "<exact text>",
    "assertion_triple": "{\"subject\": \"<person>\", \"relationship\": \"<PREDICATE>\", \"object\": \"<value>\"}",
    "certainty": "0.95",
    "temporal_context": "<current_incident|prior_incident|general_claim>",
    "is_denial": <true|false>,
    "is_boilerplate": false,
    "temporal_validity": "{\"t_valid_from\": null, \"t_valid_until\": null}",
    "metadata": "{\"time_window\": \"<if applicable>\"}" 
  }
], "edges": []}

PREDICATES FOR THIS PASS:
- DENIED_PRIOR_INCIDENT (denial of prior accidents - ALWAYS set is_denial=true)
- HAD_PRIOR_INCIDENT (admission or documented prior incident)
- WAS_IN_SCOPE (acting in course of employment)
- WAS_NOT_IN_SCOPE (not acting in employment scope)
- MISSED_WORK_FOR (time off work due to incident)

EXAMPLE:
Input: "Maria Lopez has not been involved in any motor vehicle accidents in the past 10 years. However, company records show she was involved in a minor fender-bender on June 10, 2018 in San Francisco. She also had a collision on February 15, 2019 in Daly City.

James Reed was acting in the course and scope of his employment with Green Valley Trucking at the time of the collision. He had been released from duty 30 minutes before the incident.

As a result of her injuries, Lopez missed 4 weeks of work."
